title: AUTH-010 Session Revocation Journal Migration Contract
purpose: Persist the immutable user.session.revoked publication intent in the same D1 transaction that removes a caller-owned Better Auth session.
constraints: one user.session.revoked event per Session resource_id
payload must be valid JSON object
status is PENDING, PUBLISHED or FAILED
nonGoals: No user/device/session credential fields copied from Better Auth
No new Worker, D1, Queue or Service Binding
No production D1 migration or deployment implied by source-level code
